componentDefinitions.label: Observation quality
componentDefinitions.meaning: Whether the aggregate analytical target is sufficiently observed rather than censored or missing.

componentDefinitions.label: Post-event coverage
componentDefinitions.meaning: Whether enough post-event night-light acquisitions are available for the analytical window.

componentDefinitions.label: Context coverage
componentDefinitions.meaning: Whether the event has enough reviewed contextual point coverage for the current workflow.

componentDefinitions.label: Covariate completeness
componentDefinitions.meaning: Whether the reviewed population covariate is complete enough for the current analytical role.

componentDefinitions.label: Data integrity
componentDefinitions.meaning: Whether internal missingness and non-missing values pass the consistency check.

bandDefinitions.label: Observation-ready
bandDefinitions.meaning: The reviewed components meet the current mainline analysis-admission threshold.

bandDefinitions.label: Sensitivity-only
bandDefinitions.meaning: The event can inform sensitivity analysis, but at least one component limits mainline use.

bandDefinitions.label: Repair-first
bandDefinitions.meaning: The reviewed components require data repair before mainline analytical use.
